question: Could you generate a report that shows the number of delivered orders for each month in the years 2016, 2017, and 2018? Each column represents a year, and each row represents a month
sql:
SELECT 
  CASE month_num
    WHEN 1 THEN 'January'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'February'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'March'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'April'
    WHEN 5 THEN 'May'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'June'
    WHEN 7 THEN 'July'
    WHEN 8 THEN 'August'
    WHEN 9 THEN 'September'
    WHEN 10 THEN 'October'
    WHEN 11 THEN 'November'
    WHEN 12 THEN 'December'
  END AS month,
  CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN year_num = 2016 THEN cnt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS INTEGER) AS "2016",
  CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN year_num = 2017 THEN cnt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS INTEGER) AS "2017",
  CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN year_num = 2018 THEN cnt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS INTEGER) AS "2018"
FROM (
  SELECT 
    CAST(SUBSTR(order_delivered_customer_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year_num,
    CAST(SUBSTR(order_delivered_customer_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) AS month_num,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM olist_orders
  WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
    AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year_num, month_num
)
GROUP BY month_num
ORDER BY month_num
